name: sklavit-idle-handoff
description: After an idle stretch, while the prompt cache is still warm, runs /mattpocock-skills:handoff with a keep-list brief.

idleMinutes.title: Idle minutes
idleMinutes.description: Minutes idle before the handoff runs. 50 leaves 10 minutes before a 1-hour prompt cache expires.

minTokens.title: Minimum conversation tokens
minTokens.description: Skip smaller conversations: a cold re-read of them is cheap. The system prompt and tools do not count.
